author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before: a closed teardrop shell with a spiral stamped inside and no tentacles, reading as a snail shell or a cinnamon bun. After: the reference's composition: a big r14 outer whorl with a straight opening line into an inner coil, the whorl trailing on as the right tentacle, and a left tentacle dropping from the opening with a hook.
omissions: The inner coil is a 3/4 turn (the reference's extra inward curl can't keep 8 spacing), and the right tentacle's end curl is flattened into a straight tip.
